HISTORY_PURPOSE: Native source-pinned checkpoint persistence and exact cold historical reconstruction of owned event range
HISTORY_START_BOUNDARY: Selected native bundle.initial, not inferred from report chronology or checkpoint.current
LEDGER_REQUIREMENTS: Exact first/last event roots/heads where events exist; no invented membership
PARENT_REQUIREMENTS: parent_snapshot matches preceding native state; parent_event matches preceding event identity
REPLAY_REQUIREMENTS: Native _replay equality is exact snapshot_id(state)==snapshot_id(bundle.current); semantic equivalence alone insufficient
REQUIRED_EVENT_TYPES: Existing ExecutionEvent types admitted by native codec for exact selected prefix; no named positive A14 event because recompute is an observation
REQUIRED_ORDER: Native sequence order 1..N; ancestors before descendants
STATE_TRANSITION_REQUIREMENTS: Historical event replay must reproduce after_snapshot identities and final current identity exactly
